newsitem.title: UK: ReliaStar opens reinsurance unit in London.
newsitem.headline: ReliaStar opens reinsurance unit in London.

text.p: The US insurance firm ReliaStar Life Insurance has opened a health and accident reinsurance subsidiary in London, the company said on Wednesday.

The unit, ReliaStar Reinsurance Group (UK), received authorisation from the UK's Department of Trade and Industry earlier this month and has joined the London International Insurance and Reinsurance Market Association (LIRMA).
"London is the reinsurance capital of the world. In order for us to be better suited to the market, we needed a physical presence here," said ReliaStar Life chief executive John Turner.
The group, the latest in a series of U.S.-owned reinsurers to open in London, has paid-up capital of 7.5 million stg and a margin of solvency guarantee from its parent of $60 million.
It will write medical expense insurance, business and travel accident and war risk insurance through the LIRMA stamp.

It will also underwrite "key man" insurance such as the $21 million policy placed at Lloyd's of London by the Versace group for its founder, fashion designer Gianni Versace, before his murder earlier this month

Jonathan Bowers, managing director of the new subsidiary said LIRMA membership was "essential" for reinsurance companies such as his, particularly because of the access it brings to processing facilities.
